ATF4.blurb: In mouse ATF4, positive-acting uORF1 promotes reinitiation at inhibitory uORF2; eIF2 phosphorylation delays reinitiation so ribosomes bypass uORF2 and reach the ATF4 coding region.

MDM2.blurb: Two promoters give a long leader with two uORFs, loaded with ribosomes inefficiently, and a short leader from the internal p53-responsive promoter, translated efficiently.

BRCA1.blurb: Alternative leaders: 5'-UTRb (longer) is translated less efficiently than 5'-UTRa, attributed to stable structure from a truncated Alu element and upstream AUGs.

ATF5.blurb: Alternative first exons give 5'-UTRalpha and 5'-UTRbeta; both repress translation, but only 5'-UTRalpha repression is released by amino-acid limitation, via eIF2alpha phosphorylation.

ERBB2.blurb: The HER-2 transcript leader contains a short conserved uORF that represses downstream translation; mutating its upstream start codon relieved most of the inhibition.

ESR1.blurb: Multiple promoters produce ER-alpha mRNAs whose 5'-UTRs carry one to six uORFs; some leaders strongly inhibit translation, with leaky scanning and reinitiation.

DDIT3.blurb: A single uORF with poor start-site context blocks CHOP translation; stress-induced eIF2 phosphorylation lets scanning ribosomes bypass it and translate CHOP.

RICTOR.blurb: Two RICTOR 5' leaders differing only slightly gave different reporter protein output, possibly via altered RNA secondary structure near the 5' cap (TrIP-seq follow-up).

SRSF5.blurb: Both tested SRSF5 5' leaders carry two uORFs, close to or far from the start codon; reinitiation after uORF translation was suggested to affect output.

CCNE2.blurb: Two CCNE2 isoforms differing in both 5' and 3' UTRs were tested; isoform-level translational control was proposed to possibly act via the 5' UTR.

findings.title: MDM2: short P2 leader translated better than long P1 leader
findings.evidence: MDM2-224's first exon (chr12:68809002-68809086) lies in intron 1 of the P1 transcripts (internal P2 promoter; 89-nt leader, no fully upstream uORF), MDM2-209 starts in P1 exon 1 (same exon as MANE; 305-nt leader, 2 uORFs), and both use the same start codon (chr12:68809212).

findings_skipped.BRCA1: 5'UTRa/5'UTRb not mappable with confidence: abstract gives no coordinates/sequence and the JBC full text was not retrievable; candidate long-exon-1 isoforms (BRCA1-226/244/258) not verified to contain the truncated Alu.
findings_skipped.RICTOR: Paper's two leaders differ by nine nucleotides; Ensembl 116 RICTOR leaders (22 vs 167 nt) do not match that.
findings_skipped.SRSF5: Paper names SRSF5-002/-005 (old Havana names) but the text does not state which is translated better; not mapped.
findings_skipped.CCNE2: Isoforms differ in both 5' and 3' UTRs; no 5'-leader-only direction stated.
